packageRules.description: github-actions: pin SHAs and auto-merge after the 7-day quarantine.
git submodules (.shdoc is the only one left, since bats moved to the flake devShell): group and auto-merge after the quarantine.

flake.lock (nixpkgs) bumps: auto-merge once CI is green. CI validates the exact locked toolset and nix flake check (treefmt --ci) goes red if a bumped formatter would change output, so a green run is safe to merge.

customManagers.description: SchemaStore master HEAD tracker for the JSON Schema URL consumed by .ci/check-jsonschema. SchemaStore publishes no releases/tags, so master HEAD is the only signal; the global 7-day minimumReleaseAge applies.

bats-assert master HEAD tracker for the revision flake.nix pins via overrideAttrs. The pin is deliberate: nixpkgs ships bats-assert 2.1.0, which has no assert_stderr/refute_stderr, and the repo's whole #274 stderr convention depends on them. Without this manager the pin would be frozen with nothing watching it. Renovate cannot compute the matching fetchFromGitHub hash, so a rev bump it opens goes red until the hash is regenerated by hand - see the comment beside the pins in flake.nix.

bats-support master HEAD tracker for the revision flake.nix pins via overrideAttrs, alongside the bats-assert entry above. Same hash caveat: a Renovate rev bump needs its fetchFromGitHub hash regenerated by hand before CI goes green.
